title: Fractal dimensions and quasisymmetric packing-minimalities of some homogeneous Moran sets
summary: In this paper, we study the upper box dimensions, the packing dimensions and the quasisymmetric minimalities of some homogeneous Moran sets. We obtain the upper box dimension formula and the packing dimension formula for three classes of homogeneous Moran sets under some conditions. And two classes of them with packing dimension 1 are shown to be quasisymmetrically packing-minimal.
